g.text: Title: Minimum core - RESET BOOT and optional HSE

g.desc: Title: Minimum core - RESET BOOT and optional HSE

g.text: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.desc: HARDWARE REVIEW DRAFT - NOT RELEASED FOR PCB

g.text: CONTROLLER | 4.75-5.25 V header input | common-ground minimum core

g.desc: CONTROLLER | 4.75-5.25 V header input | common-ground minimum core

g.text: SW2 pulls NRST LOW. Pull-up / supervisor remain on the supply page.

g.desc: SW2 pulls NRST LOW. Pull-up / supervisor remain on the supply page.

g.text: Hold BOOT, press/release RESET, then release BOOT. Requires option-byte setup.

g.desc: Hold BOOT, press/release RESET, then release BOOT. Requires option-byte setup.

g.text: BOOT alone does not reset. PC7/RUN_ARM defaults LOW during ROM boot.

g.desc: BOOT alone does not reset. PC7/RUN_ARM defaults LOW during ROM boot.

g.text: SW2 / SW3: TS-1101-C-W (C318938), controller TOP face, actuator UP; near board edge.

g.desc: SW2 / SW3: TS-1101-C-W (C318938), controller TOP face, actuator UP; near board edge.

g.text: Reach from stack side and press DOWN; allow holding BOOT while operating RESET.

g.desc: Reach from stack side and press DOWN; allow holding BOOT while operating RESET.

g.text: Keep clear of headers, supports and wiring. Stack access needs PCB / structure review.

g.desc: Keep clear of headers, supports and wiring. Stack access needs PCB / structure review.

g.text: HSE is also present on PF0/PF1 header pads. Do not drive them externally with the crystal fitted.

g.desc: HSE is also present on PF0/PF1 header pads. Do not drive them externally with the crystal fitted.

g.text: HSI16 / PLL may be used initially. Select actual crystal CL / ESR / drive before fitting.

g.desc: HSI16 / PLL may be used initially. Select actual crystal CL / ESR / drive before fitting.
